newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Irwin out of Wales game, Goodman in.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Irwin out of Wales game, Goodman in.

text.p: Manchester United defender Denis Irwin on Wednesday withdrew from the Republic of Ireland squad for the friendly international against Wales on February 11, the Football Association of Ireland (FAI) said in a statement.
The FAI said Irwin damaged a groin playing for Manchester United in Tuesday's 1-0 defeat by Wimbledon in an English FA Cup fourth round replay.
His place in squad goes to Ian Harte of Leeds United.
Earlier, Wimbledon striker Jon Goodman was called into the Ireland squad for the first time.
Goodman came on as an 85th minute substitute for goal scorer Marcus Gayle in the Cup defeat of Manchester United.
He replaces Waterford striker David Connolly who was forced to withdraw from the Irish squad because of a hamstring problem.
